dataset: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Change History
description: Every tracked, source-verified change to active Indian credit cards — reward rates, fees, transfer partners, lounge access, milestones and welcome benefits — as one dated changelog. Counted PER AFFECTED CARD: a bank-wide revision touching twenty cards appears as twenty events (card-impact scope). The /changes tracker and the devaluation study count the same record once per distinct change (announcement scope), so their totals are lower, not inconsistent. Announced-but-not-yet-effective changes are included as rows — compare each row's date against today before treating it as in force. Structured facts only: the full editorial write-up of each change lives on https://cardadvisor.in/changes and on the card's own page. Independent, no paid placements. Free to cite with attribution.
citation: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Change History Dataset, live snapshot as of 2026-10-11. For a citable, immutable version see https://cardadvisor.in/data/versions.

fieldDictionary.cardKey: Stable slug; the card detail page is /cards/{cardKey}.
fieldDictionary.date: Effective date at whichever precision we can stand behind: 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'YYYY-MM' (day unknown) or 'YYYY' (month unknown).
fieldDictionary.announced: Announcement/observation date, when materially different from the effective date.
fieldDictionary.type: launch | reward | fee | redemption | lounge | transfer | milestone | welcome | eligibility | network | benefit.
fieldDictionary.magnitude: major | minor — editorial sizing of the change.
fieldDictionary.status: active | reversed (announced then withdrawn before taking effect) | superseded.
fieldDictionary.title: One-line summary of the change.
fieldDictionary.before: Value before the change, where a clean before/after pair exists.
fieldDictionary.after: Value after the change, where a clean before/after pair exists.
fieldDictionary.confidence: high (primary / multi-source) | reconstructed (single source or an inferred date).
fieldDictionary.verificationTier: official (verified against the issuer's own published document) | research (no public issuer document; stands on CardAdvisor Research).
fieldDictionary.verificationUrl: The official issuer document — T&C, MITC, notice or product page (official tier only).
fieldDictionary.cardUrl: Canonical card page carrying this card's full value timeline.
fieldDictionary.noticeId: Set when the change came from ONE issuer-wide notice applied to many cards. Rows sharing a noticeId are the same real-world announcement — group by it to count issuer actions rather than per-card effects.
fieldDictionary.actId: Set when the change is one bank decision applied across cards with per-card variance (different before/after values per card). Rows sharing an actId are ONE distinct change — group by it, as with noticeId, to count issuer actions rather than per-card effects. The two keys share one namespace and never overlap.
